commissions.title: Kaftan for my father’s 70th
commissions.brief: He likes deep colours and hates anything tight. Gold embroidery, but not loud. The party is in the evening.

offer.note: I will send one main direction and one alternative.

deliveries.note: Burgundy with gold running from the chest to the hem, band collar so it sits well without a cap. Relaxed fit as you asked.

commissions.title: Groomsmen shirts, six of us
commissions.brief: Wedding in Accra in December. We want matching shirts that are not boring: short sleeves, something with pattern, and we can all wear them again.

commissions.title: Linen kaftan for work
commissions.brief: I work in a bank in Enugu. I want one kaftan I can wear on Fridays that still looks serious. Light colour, no embroidery or very little.
